top_stories.title: Energy Strikes and US-Mediated Talks
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian leadership stated a readiness to de-escalate the conflict if Russia halts targeted strikes. Meanwhile, international diplomatic efforts continue through mediated discussions concerning regional infrastructure security.

top_stories.title: EU Policy and Institutional Developments
top_stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen adjusted her schedule to attend an upcoming landmark speech by Canadian official Mark Carney. The event coincides with broader discussions surrounding transatlantic cooperation and institutional alliances.
